'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Twelve-Day War]] 
***[[List of attacks during the Twelve-Day War|Airstrikes during the Twelve-Day War]]
****The death toll from [[Israel]]'s strikes on [[Iran]] rises to more than 240, including 70 women and children. To date, at least 24 people have been killed by Iranian strikes on Israel. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/6/19/live-israel-attacks-iran-security-agency-trump-mulls-joining-conflict (Al Jazeera)]
****Iran strikes four sites in [[Central District (Israel)|central]] and [[Southern District (Israel)|southern]] Israel. The [[Soroka Medical Center]] in [[Beersheba]], is hit by an [[Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces|Iranian]] [[ballistic missile]], injuring at least 240 people. Iran says it was targeting a military site, striking an Israeli [[Israel Defense Forces|military]] and [[Israeli Intelligence Community|intelligence]] centre located near the hospital. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/19/israel-attacks-irans-arak-nuclear-reactor-as-iran-strikes-israeli-hospital (Al Jazeera)] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-iran-attacks-nuclear-news-06-19-2025-b508817b78ed8d2f6067c1516215cf94 (AP)] 
****The [[Israeli Air Force]] strikes the [[IR-40|Arak Nuclear Complex]], a [[heavy-water reactor]] near [[Arak, Iran]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-strikes-irans-arak-heavy-water-reactor-natanz-site-used-for-nuclear-development/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Rafah aid distribution killings]]
****[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] gunfire and airstrikes kill at least 92 [[Palestinians]] across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 16 people waiting for [[Humanitarian aid during the Gaza war|aid assistance]] near the [[Netzarim Corridor]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/19/israeli-attacks-kill-at-least-81-people-including-aid-seekers-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict (2022–present)|Democratic Republic of the Congo–Rwanda conflict]]
**[[M23 campaign (2022–present)|M23 campaign]]
***After three days of dialogue, the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] and [[Rwanda]] sign a provisional [[peace treaty]] and are set to begin negotiations for a draft peace treaty on June 27. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/6/19/dr-congo-and-rwanda-sign-draft-peace-agreement (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*More than ten people are killed in a mine collapse in [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://english.news.cn/africa/20250620/8b9e2c7e270b442590b5970254e32337/c.html (Xinhua)] 
*A [[rockslide]] at [[Bow Glacier Falls]] near [[Banff, Alberta|Banff]], [[Alberta]], [[Canada]], kills at least two people. Three other hikers sustained injuries. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/calgary/article/two-dead-in-banff-national-park-rock-slide-rcmp-confirm/ (CFCN-DT)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Israel–Norway relations]]
**A hand grenade is thrown into the courtyard of the residence of the [[Norway|Norwegian]] ambassador to Israel in [[Herzliya]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/explosion-norways-ambassador-residence-tel-aviv-no-injured-says-foreign-ministry-2025-06-19/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Parliament of Finland|Finnish Parliament]] votes 155–18 to withdraw from the [[Ottawa Treaty]], which bans the use of [[anti-personnel mine]]s, citing the threat [[Russia]] poses to its national security. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finnish-parliament-votes-exit-landmines-treaty-due-russia-threat-2025-06-19/ (Reuters)] [https://www.hs.fi/politiikka/art-2000011312573.html (''Helsingin Sanomat'')]
